TECHCOM SECURITIES - RESEARCH
Banking Sector - 16/11/2026
Banking Sector Report - 3Q2026 Earnings Update
Net profit reached VND 84,449 bn in 3Q, up 20.8% YoY, even as cost of funds and provision expense both rose.
Growth came from volume, not margin: loans rose 16.9% YoY while net interest margin (NIM) was almost flat, and
20/26 banks grew profit YoY; over 9M2026, the 26 listed banks earned VND 248,332 bn (+20.0%). But versus 2Q, the
pressure is clearer: cost of funds rose to 5.27%, pulling NIM down to 3.11%; the NPL ratio edged up to 2.11% and
provision expense rose 15.8%, leaving profit down 4.8%.
